history.summary: IDENTITY PROVISIONAL (verify): the CSV name 'Baina Ganga' has no web footprint; the only documented 12-Jyotirlinga replica shrine in Sagar district is Shiv Shakti Dham (also called Shiv Temple, Bamora) on the Sagar-Bamora road. Visitor reviews describe a large temple complex dominated by an almost 50-foot Shiva statue with all 12 Jyotirlingas enshrined inside an artificial cave (gufa) below it, landscaped gardens, a Mahashivratri fair, and a noted policy of not accepting donations (daan). Its founding history is undocumented online. This mapping is provisional - the 'Baina Ganga' element of the CSV name could not be corroborated. Coordinates are approximate.

town_description: Sagar is a major city in central Madhya Pradesh, headquarters of Sagar district, known for Lakha Banjara Lake, the Dr. Hari Singh Gour University, and Eran's Gupta-era temples nearby. It lies on NH-26 between Bhopal and Jabalpur. Shiv Shakti Dham, the provisional match for this record, is described on the Sagar-Bamora road just outside the city, drawing devotees for its large Shiva statue and 12-Jyotirlinga cave.
